items.title: Prepare ownership-bound Teams onboarding and removal
items.problem: Teams lifecycle improvements are requested while central extraction is still deferred.
scope: scripts/Remove-TeamsApp.ps1 and a solution-local lifecycle module if needed
azd-permissions.json and registered offline validation wiring
acceptance: Catalog propagation retries reuse exact recorded app/installation IDs.
Tenant mismatch and foreign installations fail closed; extraction waits for two consumer delivery proofs.
validation: Use the offline commands in the registered validation workflow; record the exact commands, revision and results before implementation is complete.
Run focused tests for changed behavior from tests/; fixtures do not prove live-service or endpoint behavior.
evidence: Solution-local lifecycle hardening uses exact opaque catalog and installation receipts. Installer reruns resolve only the recorded personal-installation resource; response-attributed creates checkpoint the exact ID as create-attributed-pending and a visibility retry polls only that ID before recording created. The documented 201 response with no identity becomes create-unattributed. Conflicts, non-policy errors and exhausted policy retries become create-unproven. Both unproven states require explicit adoption as adopted, never created. Ambiguous or foreign resources, tenant/user/catalog/version mismatches and incomplete or uncertain ownership fail closed.

Manual removal is limited to the exact personal installation with a complete created receipt for the same deployment and pilot. Structured HTTP 404 plus an expected Graph not-found error code is required as absence proof; DNS, timeout and unstructured text are rejected. An exact tenant/deployment-bound checkpoint progresses from delete-pending to absence-verified, allowing interrupted local receipt cleanup to resume without another delete. The installer refuses to run until that cleanup finishes, and recovery refuses any newly substituted receipt. Adopted or unproven installations and every tenant-wide catalog object are retained. No Microsoft authentication, Graph/Azure operation, assignment, send, resource mutation or delivery claim was performed; shared extraction remains deferred pending two real consumer delivery proofs.
